name: DecentralMem
oneLine: Project memory for AI assistants: write a decision once, get it back in the next chat. Served over MCP.

nodes.label: Qdrant
nodes.note: vectors, one project at a time

case.title: One project memory that *survives* a new chat.
case.lede: Every new chat with an AI assistant starts from zero, so you explain the project again. DecentralMem stores a project’s decisions, constraints and architecture notes once, through an MCP server, and hands them back in the next session. The first version runs locally and is set up for Claude.

facts.part: DecentralMem, a memory layer served over MCP
facts.result: First version works: write and search over MCP, set up for Claude
facts.note: Only the Claude side is built. Adapters for GPT-4o, Gemini and local models exist as stubs in the code.

case.pattern: one source of truth, a vector index derived from it, and a budget on what comes back

details.title: Postgres first
details.chose: PostgreSQL as the record, with Qdrant as an index that can be rebuilt from it
details.because: If the vector store is down, an item is late to search, not lost

details.title: Memory on a budget
details.chose: A token budget per model, and three kinds of memory that are never dropped
details.because: Memory shouldn’t crowd out the conversation, and the project’s rules matter most

changes.change: First version: write and search over MCP, setup guides for Claude, a cross-session test and 49 others
